title: Jagged Crispy Mediterranean Fish Skewers
description: A briny and crispy Mediterranean dish featuring Thai fish sauce and a sweet twist, perfect for a monsoon evening, this egg-free friendly recipe is sure to delight.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together Thai fish sauce, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Add the fish pieces to the bowl and marinate for 15 minutes.
Thread the marinated fish pieces onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Sprinkle the pomegranate seeds, parsley, crushed candy canes, salt, and pepper over the fish.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until cooked through.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 2 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the skewers from the oven and serve immediately.
